title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Same start, every practice
hook: How do the first five minutes of your practice look?
intro: Kids arrive one at a time.
Some kick balls around. Some stand and wait.
statement: A familiar start tells kids practice has begun.
q1: Do you open with the same warm-up every time —
q2: or change it up to keep things fresh?
q3: What helps your team settle in fastest?
t1: Both can work. But practice starts sooner
t2: when kids know what to do without being told.
cta: Coaches — how do you start practice?
ctaLines: Same warm-up. Same spot. Same first drill.
ctaPrompt: Share your opening habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How do the first five minutes of your practice look?
Kids arrive one at a time. Some kick balls around. Some stand and wait.
A familiar start tells kids practice has begun.
The same start every time, or something new. Every team is different.
How do you start practice? Share your habit in the comments.
